lines.hz: 你先去洗澡，然后我给你讲个故事。

grammar.point: 把 + object + verb + result or direction complement
grammar.en: The thing handled is put after 把; the verb is followed by a complement that says the result (好, 干净, 完) or the direction (出来, 过去).

drills.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
I'm downstairs; bring the umbrella down to me.

drills.q: 你把这个节目看___就去写作业。
drills.en: Finish watching this programme and then go and do your homework.

drills.q: 别着急，我把你的行李搬___房间里去了。
drills.en: Don't worry, I carried your luggage into the room.

grammar.en: First…, then…, after that…. 再 is for actions that have not happened yet; 又 is for ones that have.

drills.q: 起床以后，我___洗澡，然后吃早饭。
